newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA THRASH INDIA TO CLINCH SERIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA THRASH INDIA TO CLINCH SERIES.

text.p: South Africa's cricketers took a winning 2-0 lead in their three match series against India when the tourists collapsed for a third time in four innings in Cape Town on Monday.
South Africa clinched a 282-run victory on the fifth day as India were bowled out for 144 in their second innings having been set a victory target of 427.
They lost the first test in Durban when they were bowled out for 100 and 66. The third test is in Johannesburg from January 16-20.
India's hopes of saving the second test effectively disappeared early on Monday with the dismissals of Sachin Tendulkar for nine and Mohammad Azharuddin for two.
